original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a highly available and scalable Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
  cluster for a multi-tenant SaaS application.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: The VPC ID where the Aurora cluster will be deployed.
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: >-
      A list of at least two private subnet IDs in different Availability Zones
      for the Aurora cluster.
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: >-
      The Security Group ID of the application servers that will connect to the
      database.
  MasterUsername:
    Type
